race.comment: The big one of the day, which brings together a typically competitive race for one of these Western Districts Cups. MIRACLE SPIN (2) is first-up, so spotting race fitness to most of his rivals, but he was a force in races like last campaign for Andrew Bobbin and has run top-three in half of his eight first-up runs. A recent trial win hints that he'll be forward enough to play a role here. TIKEMYSON (8) had been struggling to rediscover form of previous campaigns until last start, when he returned to form in a big way. Now he's got the confidence back he is right in this. CHIEF LITTLE ROCK (3) is a former highly-rated import who hasn't found his best form in Australia but will find this easier than recent outings. VIRTUOUS CIRCLE (4) is another who's been tested in better races than this over a little further of late and last start suggested he might be better off at this sort of trip. OMNIC (10) has been a model of consistency in easier races, so warrants respect although up in grade
